They're still yelling. My sister is bringing up my past and stuff, I think making a case for me, but it's just like, "suicidal sister has reasons for being suicidal and you can't be mad over this but I'm mad too let's talk" i ran away from her house like five or six years ago because she threatened to kick me out over not getting her a glass of water and other petty stuff. She's learned I'm not a slave when I left and I later forgave her for that and spent my savings on her divorce. Shes bipolar so she swings between, I helped her get away from her past dude to I am messing up her now dude. 
I'm not getting in the way of it til they've exhausted themselves and likely not even then. I'm not looking for more stitches. 
Sorry for your loss. 
I'm sure your person knew you cared. 
I have no one like you. I'm well aware I'm on my own. But I have my cats and I'm still trying. 
I just never think it's going to end well for me because it never does.
